dedupe_keys.name: rmp map epa chemical facility risk management plans with api data liberation project

description: An open map and API of US chemical facility risk management plans. The RMP Map page says the database holds Risk Management Plans that facilities handling extremely hazardous substances file under Clean Air Act section 112(r), obtained by FOIA request by the Data Liberation Project, a project of the nonprofit MuckRock. It includes facility information, chemicals in use, risk assessments, accident prevention measures and five-year accident histories, but excludes off-site consequence analysis data; it was last updated on 5 February 2026 with data through 30 December 2025. The API documentation lists free endpoints to search facilities by state, ZIP, chemical, program level, NAICS code or accident history, with GeoJSON output for facilities and accidents. Coverage is the United States. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC-BY-SA-4.0. For simulation it locates hazardous chemical sites and their accident records for natech exposure analysis. A related catalogue record is EPA Risk Management Plan information.
